restaurantName: The Randolph Hotel by Graduate Hotels
bio: The Randolph Hotel by Graduate Hotels is a landmark building, in the heart of the world-famous university city of Oxford.  Following a complete renovation, the hotel once again oozes charm and elegance, with sumptious interiors and beautiful architecture, in a historic setting. The hotel has played host to presidents and prime ministers, and the Morse Bar is instantly recognisable as the watering hole of Colin Dexter's world-famous detective, Inspector Morse.  Afternoon Tea is served in the Drawing Room, Lancaster Room and The Alice, the epitome of English style and charm. Why not add a a glass Of Coates & Seely English Sparkling Wine with the Champagne Afternoon Tea for that extra sense of luxury?  Enjoy an Afternoon Tea with a contemporary twist created by Executive Chef Rhys Grayson from The Alice. Delicate sandwiches could include smoked salmon, free-range egg, and coronation chicken and watercress, followed by traditional warm scones served with clotted cream and strawberry jam. Sweet treats could include a Baked Vanilla Cheesecake and a Blackberry Meringue Tart.  Choose from a selection of speciality teas, including English Breakfast, Lychee and Rose Noir and Darjeeling.  If you're searching for an even more memorable experience, savour their perfectly prepared English Afternoon Tea accompanied by music from a live pianist playing an eclectic mixture of chart hits, loved classics and piano themes. Enjoy delicious savoury and sweet treats in the stunning surrounds of the Drawing or Lancaster rooms whilst you soak up the atmosphere. The most wonderful weekend treat. Every Saturday & Sunday 12pm - 4:00pm.
